Current_Shadow_Subsystem_Behavior: Reads predecessors via GROUP_CONCAT in get_faas(); create_faas() only saves scalar prevtdno on wp_assessor_faas and does NOT insert into wp_assessor_faas_previous.
Identified_Gap_in_Shadow: Creating a FAAS in shadow module leaves wp_assessor_faas_previous empty for newly created declarations.
Target_Behavior_Within_Shadow: Update create_faas() and update_faas() to insert/upsert rows into wp_assessor_faas_previous with snapshot fields.
Validation_Tests: Test creating FAAS with 2 predecessors; verify wp_assessor_faas_previous rows are inserted and returned in get_faas().

ETRACS_Capability: Electronic vs Recorded Predecessor distinction (3-Case Model)
Current_Shadow_Subsystem_Behavior: get_faas() performs fallback lookup on prevtdno if snapshot empty, but doesn't distinguish electronic, recorded, or legacy unresolved.
Identified_Gap_in_Shadow: UI/API does not return resolution_status; front-end modal cannot differentiate electronic parent from recorded historical text.
Target_Behavior_Within_Shadow: Expose resolution_status in get_faas() based on prevfaasid presence and resolution; preserve dangling IDs as LEGACY_UNRESOLVED.
Validation_Tests: Verify get_faas() returns resolution_status ('ELECTRONIC', 'RECORDED_ONLY', 'LEGACY_UNRESOLVED') for tested FAAS rows.

ETRACS_Capability: Predecessor snapshot value capture on creation
Current_Shadow_Subsystem_Behavior: EtracsPropertyFormModal auto-populates prev snapshot fields into form state on selection, but only saves to flat columns on wp_assessor_faas.
Identified_Gap_in_Shadow: Snapshot values are not recorded into wp_assessor_faas_previous on manual creation.
Target_Behavior_Within_Shadow: Persist prevowner, prevpin, prevav, prevmv, prevareasqm, preveffectivity into wp_assessor_faas_previous rows.
Validation_Tests: Test manual FAAS creation with predecessor; verify snapshot values are locked in wp_assessor_faas_previous.

ETRACS_Capability: Detailed assessment schedule per actual use (rpu_assessment)
Current_Shadow_Subsystem_Behavior: get_rpu_detail() reads rpu_assessment; EtracsPropertyFormModal displays lines, but create_faas() does NOT insert rpu_assessment lines.
Identified_Gap_in_Shadow: New FAAS creations in shadow module do not persist child rpu_assessment lines, storing only scalar totals on wp_assessor_rpu.
Target_Behavior_Within_Shadow: Allow create_faas() and update_faas() to receive assessment lines array and insert/update rows in wp_assessor_rpu_assessment.
Validation_Tests: Test creating a FAAS with residential and commercial assessment lines; verify rows in wp_assessor_rpu_assessment.

ETRACS_Capability: Multi-state declaration lifecycle (INTERIM -> FORAPPROVAL -> CURRENT -> CANCELLED)
Current_Shadow_Subsystem_Behavior: create_faas() hardcodes state = 'CURRENT'. cancel_faas() only permits cancelling CURRENT records.
Identified_Gap_in_Shadow: No ability to save draft appraisal as INTERIM or submit as FORAPPROVAL within the shadow module.
Target_Behavior_Within_Shadow: Support state parameter in create_faas() ('INTERIM', 'FORAPPROVAL', 'CURRENT') and add approve endpoint setting dtapproved and state = 'CURRENT'.
Validation_Tests: Test saving INTERIM FAAS draft, transitioning to FORAPPROVAL, and approving to CURRENT.

Current_Shadow_Subsystem_Behavior: cancel_faas() sets state='CANCELLED', cancelreason, canceldate, cancelnote, cancelledbytdnos, and cancelledtimestamp.
Identified_Gap_in_Shadow: Fully functional in backend, but EtracsPropertyTable cancel dialog does not prompt for cancelling TD number.
Target_Behavior_Within_Shadow: Enhance Cancel modal in EtracsPropertyTable to capture cancelled_by_tdnos alongside cancel_reason and cancel_date.
Validation_Tests: Test cancelling a FAAS via UI; verify cancelreason, canceldate, and cancelledbytdnos are populated.

ETRACS_Capability: RPU and RealProperty creation and updates
Current_Shadow_Subsystem_Behavior: create_faas() creates separate real_property, rpu, and entity rows and links them via foreign keys on wp_assessor_faas.
Identified_Gap_in_Shadow: rpumaster continuity is not updated when creating new revision of an existing parcel.
Target_Behavior_Within_Shadow: Update create_faas() to accept existing realpropertyid or rpumasterid to link subsequent declarations to existing parcel root.
Validation_Tests: Test creating subsequent revision FAAS linking to existing realpropertyid; verify shared parcel root.

ETRACS_Capability: Replica write vs sync collision boundary
Current_Shadow_Subsystem_Behavior: Assessor_Etracs_Sync::trigger_sync() executes wpdb->replace() on all tables, overwriting any local edits with remote ETRACS state.
Identified_Gap_in_Shadow: Local edits or new transactions created in shadow tables will be overwritten if a full sync pull is executed from external ETRACS.
Target_Behavior_Within_Shadow: Document shadow table ownership policy: Either designate shadow as local-first and disable pull sync, or tag locally created rows to prevent overwrite.
Validation_Tests: Verify sync pull behavior against locally modified records; establish write-safeguard rules.

ETRACS_Capability: Tax Declaration Preview & Lineage Traversal in Shadow
Current_Shadow_Subsystem_Behavior: TaxDeclarationPreviewModal renders full standard ETRACS Tax Declaration with assessment lines, classification, and signatories.
Identified_Gap_in_Shadow: Preview modal does not render visual multi-predecessor DAG or history chain.
Target_Behavior_Within_Shadow: Add predecessor lineage tab or accordion in TaxDeclarationPreviewModal displaying historical predecessor chain from wp_assessor_faas_previous.
Validation_Tests: Open TaxDeclarationPreviewModal for a FAAS with 2 predecessors; verify predecessor details render cleanly.

ETRACS_Capability: Dedicated isolated authoring tables immune to sync
Current_Shadow_Subsystem_Behavior: Currently both replicated ETRACS data and local edits live in the same wp_assessor_faas table, risking sync overwrite.
Identified_Gap_in_Shadow: No physical separation between source-replicated records and local authored transactions.
Target_Behavior_Within_Shadow: Establish wp_assessor_etracs_authored_faas, predecessors, and assessments tables completely unreferenced by trigger_sync().
Validation_Tests: Execute full ETRACS sync pull; verify zero authored records are touched, overwritten, or deleted.

ETRACS_Capability: Multi-tier draft, review, and approval state machine
Current_Shadow_Subsystem_Behavior: Currently create_faas defaults to CURRENT; no formal approval gate or audit of approving user.
Identified_Gap_in_Shadow: Authoring records lack DRAFT -> SUBMITTED -> APPROVED -> CANCELLED workflow gates.
Target_Behavior_Within_Shadow: Implement dedicated lifecycle endpoints with role checks, recording dtapproved and approved_by user ID.
Validation_Tests: Test draft authoring by editor, submission, and final signoff by municipal assessor.

ETRACS_Capability: TD collision detection across replica and authoring namespaces
Current_Shadow_Subsystem_Behavior: Duplicate TD checks currently only inspect local wp_assessor_faas table on save.
Identified_Gap_in_Shadow: Locally authored declaration could use a TD number already belonging to a source-replicated declaration.
Target_Behavior_Within_Shadow: Implement cross-namespace collision preflight checking both read-only replica and active authored declarations.
Validation_Tests: Attempt to create authored declaration with TD matching historical replica; verify explicit collision error.

ETRACS_Capability: Tabbed separation of Replica Archive vs Local Authoring
Current_Shadow_Subsystem_Behavior: EtracsPropertyTable blends all records without distinguishing historical replica from local drafts.
Identified_Gap_in_Shadow: Users cannot visually distinguish read-only archive records from editable authored drafts.
Target_Behavior_Within_Shadow: Add segmented tab control ('Historical Replica' vs 'Local Authoring') with status chips and role-restricted actions.
Validation_Tests: Verify viewer sees read-only archive; assessor sees authoring tabs with approve and cancel capabilities.
